summary_en: Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited corrected its tender offer filing for SEED Co. Ltd. following shortened foreign exchange waiting period approval on September 4, 2026. The acquirer became able to purchase SEED shares from that date. This correction does not constitute a change in purchase conditions as defined by law.
title_en: Notice Regarding Correction of Tender Offer Commencement Announcement Accompanying Submission of Amended Public Notice of Tender Offer by Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited
translation_en_brief:
Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited, a bidder seeking to acquire SEED Co. Ltd., corrected its tender offer filing on September 7, 2026, following approval for shortened waiting period under the Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act. The regulatory approval came on September 3, 2026, enabling the bidder to commence purchases of SEED shares effective September 4, 2026.

The correction addresses changes in the disclosure items necessitated by the shortened waiting period. The company explicitly stated that this correction does not constitute a change in purchase conditions under Article 27, Section 2, Paragraph 1 of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. The amended disclosure updates certain conditions and methods concerning withdrawal or cancellation of the tender offer, incorporating relevant regulatory provisions.
